TERMINATIONOFLEASE THIS TERMINATION OF LEASE (this "Termination"), is made as of June 26, 2025, but effective as of March31,2023,by and between1609BroadwayLLC,a Delaware limited liability company having an address at 551 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York 10176 ("Landlord"), and Times New York 10176 ("Tenant"). RECITALS WHEREAS, Landlord is the owner of the fee estate in certain property commonly known as and located at 1609-1611 Broadway, New York, New York, as more particularly set forth on Exhibit A attached hereto (the "Property"); WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Assignment and Assumption of Ground Lease Agreements, dated as of December 28, 2022, by and between 1609-11 Broadway, LLC, a New York limited liability company, and The Sylvia Riese Family Limited Partnership, a New York limited partnership (collectively,“Assignor"), and Landlord, Landlord assumed all of the Assignor's right, title and interest in and to those certain ground lease agreements set forth on Exhibit B attached hereto (collectively, the "Ground Lease Agreements")with respect to the Property; WHEREAS, Landlord is the landlord (or sublandlord, as the case may be), and Tenant is the tenant (or the subtenant, as the case may be), under each of the Ground Lease Agreements; WHEREAS,Landlord and Tenant desire to terminate eachof the Ground LeaseAgreements and remove the same of record; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements hereinafter set forth and for other good and valuable consideration,the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Termination. Landlord and Tenant agree and acknowledge that each of the Ground Lease Agreements is hereby terminated in its entirety and shall be of no further force or effect.Each of the Ground LeaseAgreementsshall bereleased ofrecord. 2. Counterparts. This Termination may be executed in multiple counterparts,each of which shall be document. A signed copy of this Termination delivered by facsimile, email, or other means of electronic transmission shall be deemed to have the same legal effect as delivery of an original signed copy of this Termination.
